verdicts.tldr: gno.land's real app fails boot on a refused genesis and boots the corrected file on the same DB, at head
verdicts.details: Head: boot 1 (doc 100, app 999) returns 'InitChain rejected the genesis: InitialHeight mismatch'; boot 2 on the same memdb boots at 100 when the app state is corrected and at 999 when the doc is. Merge base: boot 1 boots and commits block 100 on the refused genesis, so the ADR's Context line holds too.
verdicts.evidence: head: 'boot doc=100 app=100: booted, docInitialHeight=100 firstBlock=100', 'boot doc=999 app=999: booted, docInitialHeight=999 firstBlock=999', PASS; base: 'boot doc=100 app=999: booted, docInitialHeight=100 firstBlock=100', FAIL 'a refused genesis must not boot'
verdicts.refuted_by: replay.go:346 if res.IsErr() { return nil, fmt.Errorf("InitChain rejected the genesis: %w", res.Error) }
